about: Template decisions every app starts from. Agents do not reopen these. To change one, write a change request.

decisions.why: What the store pack uses and what the agent writes best.
No native engine binary, so it installs in sandboxes and runs on serverless.

decisions.choice: Postgres. Neon in production, one database per app
decisions.why: Sign-ups must persist. Serverless hosting has no durable local files.

decisions.choice: shadcn/ui components copied into src/components/ui, Radix primitives, Tailwind CSS 4 with CSS variable tokens
decisions.why: Accessibility is handled, the code is owned by the app, and the look settings can drive every component.
Keeps visitor and owner input inside the schema.

decisions.choice: Playwright end-to-end scripts in e2e/, plus one check per edge in specs/edges.json
decisions.why: Verification is automatic; a run passes only when these pass.

decisions.choice: One Vercel project per app, deployed directly from the app folder with the Vercel CLI. No GitHub repository is required in this version
decisions.why: Fewer moving parts for a one-page site. The owner can download the source as a zip.

decisions.choice: Owner-editable words, images and visibility live in the database, not in code
decisions.why: Edits are instant and need no rebuild.

decisions.choice: None in this version. Sign-ups are stored and downloaded, nothing is sent
decisions.why: Keeps the site free of an email service and a verified domain.
A waitlist site takes no money.
